title: nan
authors: Saeedi S.; Nagaty A.; Thibault C.; Trentini M.; Li H.
key_contribution: Presents a perception and navigation system for autonomous quadrotor navigation in GPS-denied environments with localization, mapping, and waypoint following validated in simulation and real world.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
